<!-- AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/GenPauta.java from Editora's pauta.json and pom.xml. Do not edit by hand. -->

[Pauta](https://pauta-project.dev/) is the set of guidelines Editora and its sibling apps follow, so they
look and work the same on Windows, macOS and Linux. Each rule has an ID and a level: a **MUST** is
required, a **SHOULD** is expected unless there is a stated reason.

Editora is working toward **[Pauta 6.0.1](https://pauta-project.dev/6.0.1/)**.

**Pauta conformance: Partial.** Editora does not meet every MUST of this edition yet: 74 are pending.

| Conformance | Means |
|---|---|
| Complete | Every MUST and every SHOULD is met, does not apply, or is a recorded deviation. |
| Core | Every MUST is met; one or more SHOULDs are still pending. |
| Partial | One or more MUSTs are still pending. The app says *Working toward*, not *Built to*. |

The conformance is worked out from the list below, never typed in, so it cannot claim more than the list
shows. The same list is in the app: **Help → Pauta Conformance** opens it, and **About** names the edition
and the conformance.
